Bride Refuses Drunk Groom, Honored by Police in Chhattisgarh

In Chhattisgarh, a bride called off her wedding after discovering the groom was intoxicated. The incident occurred before the ceremony, and the bride's decision was reportedly supported by the police. Authorities stated the action sends a message against alcohol abuse.
